exposure: extending epidural analgesia following epidural labor analgesia
Extending epidural analgesia following epidural labor analgesia for intrapartum cesarean section
cohort: 1254 singleton parturient who failed trial of epidural labor analgesia and underwent intrapartum cesarean section
finding: Extending epidural analgesia using the well-functioning epidural catheter for epidural labor analgesia was a reliable and effective anesthetic method for intrapartum cesarean section.
